# fptcloud_database_resources (Data Source)
 
Lists every database cluster and DB proxy of a VPC, with the nodes, CPU, RAM, disk and backup they use, and the totals of the VPC.
 
## Schema
 
### Required
 
- `vpc_id` (String) The Id of the VPC.
 
### Read-Only
 
- `clusters` (List of Object) The database clusters of the VPC. `database` and `proxy` hold `node_count`, `cpu`, `ram_gb` and `disk_gb`; `proxy.items` lists the DB proxies (`lb_cluster_id`, `lb_cluster_name`, `lb_type`, `status` and their own usage); `backup.used_gb` is null when the cluster has no backup data.
- `id` (String) The Id of the VPC.
- `total` (Object) Totals over all the clusters of the VPC: `cluster_count`, `pitr_enabled_count`, and `database`, `backup`, `pitr` and `proxy` usage.
 
## Example Usage
 
```terraform
data "fptcloud_database_resources" "vpc" {
  vpc_id = "ab463af6-1147-4446-92fc-3700df39ba05"
}
 
output "database_totals" {
  value = data.fptcloud_database_resources.vpc.total
}
 
output "proxies" {
  value = {
    for c in data.fptcloud_database_resources.vpc.clusters : c.cluster_id => c.proxy.items
    if length(c.proxy.items) > 0
  }
}
```
